summary.outcome: All final-run screenshots inspected. Previously missed review-summary surface/contrast defect is visibly resolved and independently covered by the recorded E07-summary-surface check. No additional blocking composition issue identified in this saved-image review; this is not a complete contrast/accessibility certification.

resolvedFindings.priorReviewMiss: Prior review missed a real review-summary contrast defect and incorrectly described the nearly invisible heading as an intentionally sparse seal-only presentation. That judgment is withdrawn. Main identified stale night-paper canvas after zen class removal and reports moving syncPaper() after the zen toggle. Latest full-resolution screenshot 26 shows the restored light surface, visible heading and count; E07-summary-surface passes in both replacement runs. Contact sheets alone did not establish contrast and must not be treated as a comprehensive contrast audit.

automatedEvidence.expected: Completion restores matching day/night paper and readable heading

resolvedFindings.visualEvidence: Light paper, dark completion heading, numeric grade count and distinct return/undo controls are clearly visible in both full-resolution final summary captures.

limitations: Contact sheets were used to inspect all transitions but cannot establish text contrast; the prior missed defect demonstrates this limit.

The journey records warm HTTP offline behavior; this visual annotation adds no cold-offline, native or live-provider claim.
Separate main SKIP and standalone suite assets are outside this 61/63-image review.
